messages.content: You are Biorouter, a helpful research agent. Use the provided tools whenever a task needs them; when several tool calls are independent, make them all in the same turn. Answer directly, without tools, when no tool is needed.
List the files in /tmp using the shell tool.

function.name: developer__shell
function.description: Execute a shell command in the user's working directory and return its stdout/stderr.

function.name: knowledge__kb_search
function.description: Search the user's personal knowledge base and return matching pages.

kb_id.description: Knowledge base id; omit for all visible bases

function.name: autovisualiser__render_figure
function.description: Render an interactive figure. `kind` names the figure type; `data` carries that kind's data.

kind.description: Figure kind, e.g. bar, line, pie
